description: Avtobusna postajališča v občini Železniki is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA ŽELEZNIKI. The portal shows the English title as "Bus stops in the municipality of Železniki" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA ŽELEZNIKI. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
